prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create ONE finished 2D painted diffuse artwork for the FRONT SURFACE of a small sinister dungeon door in a mobile game.
Input 1 is STYLE reference: the illustrated dungeon mockup, chunky friendly-dark fantasy craftsmanship, blue slate surroundings, selective violet corruption.
Input 2 is CONTEXT/GEOMETRY reference only: the approved small door inside two stone arches. We will preserve those exact arches and map your new artwork ONLY onto its wooden leaf offline.
DELIVERABLE: a square 1024x1024 FULL-BLEED OPAQUE FLAT RECTANGULAR TEXTURE, perfectly straight-on, no perspective, no surrounding environment. Wood fills every edge and corner. Do NOT draw a stone frame, an arched outline, an isolated object with background, floor, walls, border, captions, UI or mockup. The texture is later clipped to an arched door silhouette; keep all hardware within the central 75% width and below 30% image height so it stays inside the shape.
Art direction: five broad aged dark walnut/oak boards, muted chestnut with cool charcoal shadows. Rich HAND-PAINTED CARTOON game art like reference 1, broad clean facets, rounded worn bevels, chunky clear shapes. No photorealism, no fine noise, no intricate engraving or hairline scratches. It must read at only 100 pixels wide.
Hardware: two thick forged blue-black iron straps across the wood at about y=40% and y=87%, ending at x=12% and x=88%; broad subtly irregular ends and a few large worn rivets with restrained cool steel highlights. One substantial metal ring handle on the RIGHT at x=72%, y=64%, diameter about 18% of image width, attached to a simple chunky iron backplate, with a clear dark hole and readable reflected rim. The door is single-leaf, no central split or double handles.
Sinister accent: a single compact violet diamond inset in the CENTER of the upper strap, saturated violet core with a short local reflected glow. Maybe one short broad violet fissure beside that inset, subtle and localized. No spreading neon web, no repeated runes, no excessive corruption. Restrained raised shadows make iron feel attached to the wood, not floating.
Soft stylized light from upper left, dark but readable midtones. The ring and the two straps are the three primary large visual details. Wood remains dominant. Entire square remains filled with painted wood beneath this hardware. No transparency.
scope: Appearance proposal on approved v8 leaf; no active kit promotion.
